w10_T4_002618: In the morning Kira opened a box of 66 glass beads, and 7 of them were cracked, so she threw those away. At the craft market she swapped every good bead for 2 smaller beads. She then divided all the small beads equally between herself and her friend Jun, keeping her own share. In the afternoon she gave 12 of her beads to a younger cousin. In the evening she strung each bead she still had with 2 tiny charms. At the craft fair every charm scores 7 points, and Kira's charms scored more points than Jun's. How many points did Kira's charms score?
w10_T4_002619: In the morning a bakery put out 50 blueberry muffins. By noon 47 had been sold and 2 had been given to the delivery driver. In the afternoon the baker cut every muffin still on the tray into 9 sample pieces, and 2 of the pieces were eaten by the staff. The afternoon baking took ninety minutes, an hour and a half. Each muffin costs 3 dollars. In the evening 5 more sample pieces from a fresh batch were added to the sample plate. How many sample pieces were on the plate at the end of the evening?
w10_T4_002628: In the morning Ravi's manuscript stood at 43 pages. Before lunch he wrote 23 more pages, and after lunch another 46 pages. In the afternoon he printed 4 copies of every page and stacked all the printed sheets on his desk, a job that took two hours, one hundred and twenty minutes. He then added 31 printed cover sheets to the same stack. In the evening he mailed 292 sheets from the stack to his publisher. How many printed sheets were left on Ravi's desk?
w10_T4_002629: In the morning a plant nursery had 199 seed trays on its benches. It sold 73 trays to a landscaper and threw out 23 trays that had dried up. In the afternoon a delivery brought 17 fresh trays. In the evening the manager counted the stock seedling by seedling: every tray holds 6 rows, and every row holds 9 seedlings. How many seedlings did the nursery have at the evening count?
w10_T4_002630: In the morning Owen's taco truck made 111 tacos in each of 4 busy hours, all of which went into the warmer. In the afternoon the crew made 37 more, then 17 more, then a final batch of 75, adding them all to the warmer. In the evening 74 tacos that had gone cold were thrown out. Owen's rival Bella made fewer tacos in her truck that day. Counting everything that went into the warmer minus what was thrown out, how many tacos did Owen's truck have for sale that day?
w10_T4_002633: A builder's yard received 105 pallets, each holding 9 crates of bricks. The crew used up 708 whole crates on the foundation. Every crate holds 9 bricks, and the crew opened all the remaining crates to work brick by brick. They then laid 792 of those bricks in the garden wall, which is 12 metres long. How many bricks does the builder have left?
w10_T4_002634: A seaside hotel has 165 rooms in its main building and 50 rooms in an annex. During a busy week, every room used 7 fresh towels each day for 7 days, and all the used towels were sent to the laundry, where a dozen staff work. The hotel has 6 floors. By the end of the week the laundry had returned 7647 towels clean. How many towels were still at the laundry?
w10_T4_002640: Farmer Ana keeps 225 hens, and each hen laid 8 eggs this week. She packed the eggs 3 to a small box, and then bundled the boxes 3 to a crate. She sold every crate for 5 dollars at the market half a mile down the road. Out of that money she paid 416 dollars for feed, and then earned 25 dollars selling a bale of straw. Her neighbour Ben made less from his eggs this week than Ana. How many dollars does Ana have from this week's sales after paying for the feed?
w10_T4_002643: Yusuf's travel purse held 170 pounds when he left home. His father gave him 49 pounds at the station, and the train ticket cost 114 pounds from the purse. At the border he changed every pound in the purse into lira at 5 lira per pound, in a queue that took an hour and a half, ninety minutes. His aunt then handed him 74 lira, and the hotel took 231 lira from the purse. His sister Zara, travelling with him, had fewer lira in her purse. How many lira were in Yusuf's purse after paying the hotel?
w10_T4_002646: For a charity ride, Diego cycled 60 kilometres a day for 7 days. He then added a 15-kilometre detour to a viewpoint and a 53-kilometre loop on the final day. His GPS log, however, had overcounted by 69 kilometres, so that was struck from the total. His bike weighs 8 kilograms, and each day's ride took him about three hours, one hundred and eighty minutes. His sponsor pays 9 dollars for every kilometre on the corrected log. How many dollars did the sponsor pay?
w10_T4_002650: In the morning a tailor named Sofia cut 100 strips of silk from each of 3 bolts. She then found 9 spare strips in a drawer and 19 more in a bag from the previous week, and added them to the pile. In the afternoon she cut every strip into 8 equal squares for a patchwork quilt. In the evening she stitched 9 beads onto every square. Her apprentice Tomas stitched far fewer beads that day than Sofia. How many beads did Sofia stitch?
w10_T4_002651: Hugo's trading-card binder held 97 cards. He gave 75 of them to a charity sale. At a card fair he swapped every card still in his binder for 3 cards from a new series, filling the binder with only the new cards. Each of the new cards is worth about 4 dollars. He then lost 59 cards to his cousin in a game, and 2 more slipped out of the binder and were never found. How many cards are in Hugo's binder now?
w10_T4_002654: In the morning Priya's camera held 151 photos from her trip, and she deleted 23 blurry ones. In the afternoon she ordered 4 prints of every photo left on the camera and picked them all up from the shop. Her grandmother then gave her 80 old prints to add to the same album. In the evening Priya handed out 451 prints to relatives at a family dinner. How many prints did Priya have left?
w10_T4_002662: Coach Dana's badminton club received 153 tubes of shuttlecocks, but 22 tubes were crushed in transit and sent back. Every remaining tube held 8 shuttlecocks, all of which went into the club's store. Over the season the club used 824 shuttlecocks in matches, each of which lasted ninety minutes, an hour and a half. The club also lent 207 shuttlecocks to Coach Raj's club across town, whose own store is smaller than Dana's. The club has 40 members. Raj later returned 63 shuttlecocks. How many shuttlecocks are in Dana's store now?
w10_T4_002665: Nora had 12 sheets of coloured paper. She used 10 of them for a school poster and gave 1 sheet to her brother. She cut every sheet she had left into 9 strips. She used 7 of the strips to make a paper chain. Then she cut each remaining strip into 5 small squares for confetti, and 1 square blew out of the window. How many squares of confetti does Nora have?
w10_T4_002669: A kiosk at the football stadium started the day with 141 hot dogs. It gave away 46 as free samples before the match and then received 13 more from the supplier. Every hot dog it had at that point was sold during the match at 5 dollars each. The match lasted 90 minutes. The kiosk then paid 182 dollars to rent its pitch-side spot. How many dollars did the kiosk have left from its hot dog sales after paying the rent?
w10_T4_002675: Ines reads 71 pages every day for 7 days as part of a reading challenge, usually for half an hour before bed. On the weekend she reads an extra 76 pages. The challenge awards 7 points for every page read. Ines also earns a 55-point bonus for a book review and a 29-point bonus for finishing early. Her classmate Pablo earns fewer points than Ines. How many points does Ines earn in the challenge?
w10_T4_002676: Amir bought 31 packs of juice boxes for the school fair, with 6 juice boxes in every pack. During the fair he handed out 162 juice boxes. His friend Lily, who had brought fewer juice boxes than Amir, gave him her leftover 50 boxes to take home. On the way out Amir gave 24 boxes to the caretakers. How many juice boxes did Amir take home?
w10_T4_002681: In the morning Farah won 216 tickets at the fair's ring toss and 80 more at the hoop game, keeping them all in one pouch. At the prize booth in the afternoon she exchanged every ticket for 5 tokens each. She then found 55 tokens under a bench and added them to the pouch. In the evening the booth switched to a special rate: she swapped every token for 2 stamps each, and every stamp was worth 8 points on the fair's leaderboard. How many points did Farah have on the leaderboard?
w10_T4_002687: A choir has 94 singers, but 31 of them missed the rehearsal. The director split the singers who were present into 3 equal sections. Each singer in the soprano section needs 8 sheets of music, and the copier takes 4 minutes to print each sheet. The director knows that sixty minutes make an hour, but the copier logs its work in minutes. The concert hall seats 500 people. How many minutes does the copier take to print all the sheets for the soprano section?
w10_T4_002693: Greg had 119 sheets of stickers and was given 4 more sheets by his teacher. Every sheet carries 8 stickers, and he peeled them all off into one big pile. He then bundled the pile into packs of 6 stickers each, a job that took him two hours, one hundred and twenty minutes. Finally he gave half of the packs to his sister. How many packs of stickers does Greg have left?
w10_T4_002701: Marisol collected raffle tickets all week: 13 on Monday, 27 on Tuesday, 46 on Wednesday, and 53 on Thursday, keeping them all in one envelope. On Friday the organisers doubled the tickets of everyone who had entered early, so Marisol's envelope now held twice as many tickets as before. Each ticket in the envelope counts as 7 entries in the grand draw. How many entries does Marisol have in the grand draw?
w10_T4_002716: In the morning the caterers set out 163 chairs in each of the 2 halls of the conference centre. In the afternoon 12 extra chairs were brought from the storeroom and 22 more were borrowed from the cafe. The stage at the front is 10 metres wide. In the evening a late delivery added 3 chairs, and the hotel next door lent 15 more. How many chairs were set out by the end of the evening?
w10_T4_002718: In the morning a parcel depot loaded 106 crates onto each of its 8 trucks. In the afternoon the crates were opened at the sorting hall: every crate held 9 boxes, and every box held 9 parcels. The depot is 30 kilometres from the airport. In the evening 25 late parcels arrived by van and 13 more were handed in at the counter, all joining the day's sort. How many parcels went through the sorting hall that day?
w10_T4_002721: In the morning Kofi arrived at the fun fair with 50 vouchers and was given 20 more at the gate. He exchanged every voucher for 4 game tokens. In the afternoon the games switched to plastic chips, so he swapped every token for 2 chips, and then won 12 more chips at the hoopla. The fair had 9 rides in all. In the evening he lost 423 chips at the shooting gallery, and at closing time the cashier paid him 7 cents for every chip he handed in. How many cents did Kofi receive?
